calculators.title_native: Netten Brüt Maaş, Kıdem ve İhbar Tazminatı Hesaplama
calculators.title_en: Net to Gross Salary, Severance & Notice Pay Calculator
calculators.description_native: Türkiye İş Kanunu ve SGK mevzuatına uygun olarak brüt/net maaş dönüşümü, SGK işçi ve işveren payları, gelir vergisi dilimleri, asgari ücret vergi istisnası ile kıdem ve ihbar tazminatını hesaplayan detaylı araç.
calculators.formula_explanation: 1. SGK Worker Share = Gross Salary * 14% (capped at statutory SGK Ceiling = 7.5 * Minimum Wage). 2. Unemployment Worker Share = Gross Salary * 1%. 3. Taxable Base = Gross Salary - SGK Worker Share - Unemployment Worker Share. 4. Cumulative Tax Base = Previous Base + Taxable Base. Progressive Income Tax Brackets apply (15%, 20%, 27%, 35%, 40%). 5. Asgari Ücret Vergi İstisnası (Minimum Wage Exemption): Calculated Gross Income Tax and Stamp Tax are reduced by the income tax and stamp tax corresponding to the monthly Minimum Wage. 6. Stamp Tax (Damga Vergisi) = Gross Salary * 0.00759 (0.759%), minus Minimum Wage Stamp Tax exemption. 7. Net Salary = Gross Salary - SGK Worker (14%) - Unemployment Worker (1%) - Income Tax (after exemption) - Stamp Tax (after exemption) + Disability Benefit deduction. 8. Severance Pay (Kıdem Tazminatı) = Min(Gross Salary + regular side benefits, Kıdem Tazminatı Tavanı) * (Tenure Years + Tenure Months / 12). Exempt from Income Tax; subject only to 0.759% Stamp Tax. 9. Notice Pay (İhbar Tazminatı) = (Gross Salary / 30) * Statutory Notice Days (28 days for 0.5-1.5 yrs, 42 days for 1.5-3 yrs, 56 days for 3+ yrs). Subject to Income Tax (15%-40%) and Stamp Tax (0.759%).

calculators.title_native: Tapu Harcı ve Gayrimenkul Değer Artış Kazancı Vergisi Hesaplama
calculators.title_en: Real Estate Title Deed Fee & Capital Gains Tax Calculator
search_terms_native: tapu masrafı ve döner sermaye hesaplama
calculators.description_native: Türkiye'de konut/arsa alım-satımında ödenen tapu harcı, döner sermaye bedeli ile 5 yıl içinde satılan gayrimenkullerin Yİ-ÜFE endeksli Değer Artış Kazancı Vergisini hesaplayan uzman araç.
calculators.formula_explanation: 1. Title Deed Fee (Tapu Harcı): Standard statutory rate is 4% of the declared property value (must be >= municipal benchmark value / rayiç bedel). By default split as 2% Buyer + 2% Seller. Total Tapu Harcı = Declared Value * 4%. Plus fixed Revolving Fund Fee (Döner Sermaye Hizmet Bedeli + local coefficient). 2. Exemption Rule: If property is held for more than 5 full years (60 months), Capital Gains Tax (Değer Artış Kazancı Vergisi) is 0 TL. 3. If held <= 5 years: Adjusted Acquisition Price = Acquisition Price * (PPI index month before sale / PPI index month before purchase). Adjustment applies if inflation change is >= 10%. 4. Taxable Capital Gain = Sale Price - Adjusted Acquisition Price - Acquisition Title Deed Fees - Annual Exemption Allowance (statutory annual limit, e.g. TRY 87,000 in 2024 / updated annually). 5. If Taxable Capital Gain > 0, Income Tax is calculated progressively using standard Turkish Income Tax brackets (15% to 40%).

calculators.title_native: Şahıs Şirketi Vergi, Bağ-Kur ve Genç Girişimci Desteği Hesaplama
calculators.title_en: Sole Proprietorship Tax, Bağ-Kur & Young Entrepreneur Benefit Calculator
search_terms_native: şahıs şirketi gider net kar hesaplama
calculators.description_native: Türkiye'de şahıs şirketi kuran girişimciler ve freelancer'lar için aylık/yıllık gelir, gider, KDV netleştirmesi, Bağ-Kur primi, Genç Girişimci istisnası ve Gelir Vergisi dilimlerini hesaplayan finansal araç.

inputs.name: monthly_revenue
inputs.label_native: Aylık Ortalama Brüt Gelir (KDV Hariç TL)

options.label_native: Evet (3 Yıl Vergi İstisnası + 1 Yıl Bağ-Kur Primi)

calculators.formula_explanation: 1. Gross Annual Income = Monthly Revenue * 12. 2. Gross Annual Expenses = Monthly Expenses * 12. 3. Net Pre-Tax Income = Gross Annual Income - Gross Annual Expenses. 4. Young Entrepreneur Incentive (Genç Girişimci Desteği): First-time sole proprietors under age 29 receive 3 years of income tax exemption up to the statutory 75,000+ TL threshold (indexed to tax tariff tier 3) AND 1 year of state-paid Bağ-Kur social security premiums. 5. Taxable Base = Max(0, Net Pre-Tax Income - Young Entrepreneur Tax Exemption if applicable). 6. Income Tax (Gelir Vergisi) calculated on Taxable Base using Turkish progressive income tax brackets (15%, 20%, 27%, 35%, 40%). 7. Monthly Bağ-Kur Premium = Gross Minimum Wage * 34.5% (or 29.5% with 5% prompt payment incentive). 8. Fixed Monthly/Quarterly Stamp Duty (Damga Vergisi) for KDV, Muhtasar, and Geçici Vergi declarations (~statutory statutory fixed fees). 9. Net Annual Take-Home Profit = Net Pre-Tax Income - Income Tax - Annual Bağ-Kur Premiums - Annual Fixed Stamp Duties.

calculators.title_en: Commercial Rent Withholding Tax & KDV Calculator
calculators.description_native: İşyeri kiralayan şirketler ve şahıs işletmeleri için net kiradan brüt kira, %20 stopaj kesintisi veya KDV dahil toplam nakit çıkışını ve muhtasar beyanname yükümlülüğünü hesaplayan pratik araç.

options.label_native: Net Kiradan Brüt ve Stopaj Hesaplama
Brüt Kiradan Net ve Stopaj Hesaplama

calculators.formula_explanation: 1. If Landlord is Individual (Şahıs): Subject to Rent Withholding Tax (Kira Stopajı) at statutory rate of 20%. Net Rent = Gross Rent * (1 - 0.20) = Gross Rent * 0.80. Gross Rent (Brüt Kira) = Net Rent / 0.80 = Net Rent * 1.25. Rent Withholding Tax (Kira Stopajı) = Gross Rent * 0.20 = Net Rent * 0.25. Payment to Landlord = Net Rent. Payment to Tax Office (Muhtasar Beyanname) = Rent Withholding Tax. Total Business Expense = Gross Rent. 2. If Landlord is Company/Corporation (Tüzel Kişi): No withholding tax; commercial rent invoice is issued with KDV. Gross Rent = Specified Amount. KDV Amount = Rent Amount * KDV Rate (20%). Total Cash Paid to Landlord = Rent Amount * (1 + KDV Rate). Input KDV (İndirilecek KDV) can be offset against business monthly sales KDV.

calculators.title_native: Motorlu Taşıtlar Vergisi (MTV) ve Araç Noter Devir Masrafı Hesaplama
calculators.title_en: Motor Vehicle Tax (MTV) & Notary Transfer Fee Calculator
calculators.description_native: Türkiye'de sıfır veya 2. el otomobil alım-satımında güncel noter devir ücreti, plaka değişim masrafı ve motor hacmi/model yılına göre yıllık Motorlu Taşıtlar Vergisini (MTV) hesaplayan kılavuz.
calculators.formula_explanation: 1. Notary Vehicle Transfer Fee (Noter Araç Devir Masrafı): Fixed statutory notary transaction fee (~TRY 1,489+ updated annually) + registration document fee (Ruhsat basım ücreti). If plate change is selected (Plaka değişimi), additional plate printing and stamp fee is added. 2. Motor Vehicle Tax (MTV): Computed semi-annually (paid in 2 equal installments in January and July). Annual total = 2 * semi-annual installment. Formula matches Engine Capacity Bracket, Age Tier, and Registration Period. For post-2018 registrations, MTV also factors in the vehicle benchmark value (Taşıt Değeri). Electric vehicles (EVs) pay 25% of the MTV charged for an equivalent internal combustion engine capacity kW bracket.
